prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1384; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the vehicle was changing lanes. The reported mechanism is consistent with the complaints of neck and low back strain, and the force described fits the soft tissue injury diagnosed. Over seven visits, the patient received conservative care including manual therapy, a home stretching program, and graduated activity guidance. Recovery has been somewhat slower than typically expected for this type of strain, though progress has continued at each visit. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion were documented, supporting the clinical diagnosis. Neurological screening, reflexes, and straight-leg raise testing were within normal limits. The patient reports a remote, small strain to the same region years ago, which resolved completely without ongoing limitation. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Continued home exercise and follow-up as needed are recommended.
